note: Uzbekistan: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa (the former Soviet neighbours without limit, Kyrgyzstan 60 days, the long list 30, Hong Kong and Macao 10); those on the e-Visa list apply online (30 days). Indians enter visa-free only with certain third-country visas (not modelled). Everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against Cabinet Resolution No 408 of 1996, Annex 5, on Lex.uz (the Russian text, which Lex.uz marks unofficial) and Presidential Decree UP-203 (the United States' 30 days from 1 January 2026): they confirmed the unlimited, 60- and 30-day lists, and gave Hong Kong no more than 7 days, through the international airports, not 10, so Hong Kong was moved to 7 days. Macao isn't on Annex 5; its 10 days and the e-Visa list stand on Wikipedia's copy.
